ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels (dark gray/black) with a very low ratio (approx. 2-4%) of high-intensity pixels (white) concentrated on the right-hand margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (dark) distribution across the majority of the fluke surface. High-contrast white contiguous blobs are mapped exclusively to the distal-lateral margin and terminal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a narrow interior angle of approximately 40-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, jagged serrations with variable pixel amplitudes (2-8 pixels) along the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits higher amplitude peaks near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature fitted to the outer edges of both lobes, tapering to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-intensity (white) clusters localized along the right lateral margin and the apex of the right lobe lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant high-contrast (white) protrusions and textural irregularities along the outer right edge and tip, indicating heavy barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Notable asymmetry in the distribution of high-intensity edge-attached pixel clusters, favoring the right lobe distal margin.
